mutation:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest ->     name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      API_PORT: "not_a_number"

observed.failing_step: App imports on a clean machine

notes: api/main.py calls get_settings() at import time, so the 'App imports on a clean machine' step fails with 'pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for Settings' / 'api_port' / 'Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer [type=int_parsing, input_value='not_a_number', input_type=str]'. CI stops at that step, so pytest never runs and there is no pytest summary. GitHub prints job-level env in the 'env:' block of each step header, so the log also shows 'API_PORT: not_a_number' above the failing step. The field name and input value point at configuration; config.py is unchanged, so the fix is the ci.yml env block.
